item.title: Stockbridge Planning Board proposes assessment of potential Chapter 61 parcels
item.description: “I think many of us were familiar with the parcel on Interlaken Cross Road that came up for Town Meeting last year,” Chair Kate Fletcher reminded Stockbridge Planning Board members as they worked to develop a solution to Chapter 61 right-of-refusal challenges.

item.description: Couples and families alike will be able to dress up the animals—and themselves—at different stations filled with Valentine-themed scarves, glasses, or coats for the equine participants.
